subject: Backend Engineering Intern role at Ledgerline
body: I recently built a parser and served it over a REST API, and set up a 90-question CI test suite that stops merges if accuracy falls. Would you be open to referring me for the Backend Engineering Intern role at Ledgerline? If someone else is handling this hire, a quick pointer to them would help a lot. My resume is attached.
personalization_source: Containerise services with Docker and help improve our CI pipeline.
